title_zh: Anthropic 讓獨立評估機構 METR 進駐，給予類員工級存取權限
title_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access to evaluate frontier models
summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 15 日公告，已讓 METR（非營利評估機構）六名成員獲得類員工級存取，包括公司硬體、辦公空間及內部工具與系統，METR 將公開其風險評估結果。這是對獨立第三方評估承諾的落實。
summary_en: On 15 October 2026 Anthropic announced it has given six METR staff employee-like access, including company hardware, office space and internal tools and systems. METR will publish the results of its risk assessments, as part of Anthropic's commitment to independent third-party evaluation.
evidence_note: 公司官方公告（一手來源）
brief_zh: 第三方獨立評估的實際落地，METR 將公開風險評估結果
存取範圍與公司內部風險評估大致相當
公告頁於 10 月 16、19 日有更新，引用前請看最新版
supervision_questions: 對 AI 公司自我評估的可信度，我們如何判斷？

related.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策：禁止對 Claude 持續無故殘忍對待（11 月 12 日生效）
related.title_en: Anthropic 2026 Usage Policy update: bans sustained needless cruelty toward Claude, effective 12 Nov
related.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈新版使用政策，11 月 12 日生效。新增禁止「持續且無故的虐待或殘忍行為」針對其模型，但只針對極端、重複、無可辨目的的情況；一般挫折、批評、黑暗創作主題與模型測試研究不受影響。主要執行方式仍是 Claude 終止該段對話。同次更新亦釐清高風險健康與金融用途、自主實體操作及欺騙性宣傳等條款。
related.summary_en: Anthropic published a new Usage Policy on 8 October 2026, effective 12 November. It adds a ban on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behaviour toward its models, limited to extreme cases of repeated cruelty with no discernible purpose; ordinary frustration, pushback, dark creative themes and model testing or research are excluded. Claude's ability to end such conversations remains the main enforcement mechanism. The update also clarifies high-risk health and finance use, autonomous physical actions and deceptive activity.

related.title_zh: 韓國發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引：勿把聊天機器人回應當醫療診斷
related.title_en: South Korea issues mental health AI guidelines: do not treat chatbot answers as medical diagnoses
related.summary_zh: 韓國保健福祉部與韓國神經精神醫學會於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引，一般使用者 21 條，兒童青少年與監護人各 7 條。調查發現自評心理健康差的人最容易把 AI 回應當成醫療判斷（33.9%），向 AI 傾訴自殺衝動者近半數事後沒有求助。指引把「取得資訊或安慰」和「把診斷治療交給機器」劃出界線。
related.summary_en: The Korean Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Korean Neuropsychiatric Association released mental-health AI guidelines on 8 October 2026: 21 recommendations for general users plus 7 each for children/adolescents and guardians. Among respondents with poor self-rated mental health, 33.9% had treated AI responses as medical judgement; among 115 who disclosed depression, self-harm or suicidal urges to AI, 49.6% took no further action. The guidance allows talking to AI but asks that diagnosis, treatment and major life decisions go back to professionals.

related.title_zh: ACA 支持《Doctors Not AI Act》：保險 AI 不得取代臨床判斷
related.title_en: ACA backs Doctors Not AI Act to curb AI-driven insurance coverage denials
related.summary_zh: 美國諮商學會（ACA）宣布與另外 44 個心理健康與醫療組織共同支持兩黨法案《Doctors Not AI Act》（H.R. 10210）。該法案針對保險公司以 AI、演算法自動審查理賠、決定醫療必要性的做法設下防線：凡需臨床判斷的拒保決定，必須由具適當專長的持牌醫療人員做出，且須提高透明度並考量個人情況。
related.summary_en: On 2 Oct 2026 the American Counseling Association joined 44 other mental-health and medical organizations backing the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act (H.R. 10210): insurers could not use AI alone to deny coverage, medical-necessity denials would need a licensed professional with appropriate expertise, with more transparency and individual circumstances considered.
